name: GeoRCP-MIRAGE v1.1 target-validity amendment
reason: Independent raw IRF and SRF rasterization produced 165 overlap pixels across 17/3012 images. Step05E5C demonstrated boundary/rasterization ambiguity: 0 overlap pixels remain after 2-pixel simultaneous erosion and 0 pixels lie >2 px inside both regions.

region_policy.boundary_policy: retain independent class-specific SRF and IRF boundary targets
region_policy.head: retain mutually exclusive background/SRF/IRF softmax
region_policy.interior_classification_policy: set raw SRF/IRF overlap pixels to IGNORE_INDEX=255 and region_valid=0
